title: Probity in Public Life

endcard.line: Pictures: Amitabha Gupta (CC BY 4.0); IP Singh (public domain)

segments.say: Probity means being honest and upright in public life, even when no one is checking.

In twenty fourteen, the conduct rules for the All India Services spelled out the standards every officer must keep: integrity and honesty, political neutrality, merit and fairness, accountability and transparency, responsiveness to weaker sections, and courtesy.

anim.title: From values to decisions
items: Decide solely in the public interest

segments.say: They also ask officers to uphold the Constitution, take decisions solely in the public interest, and use public resources efficiently.
Rules set the standard. Institutions help check that it is met.
Lokayuktas in the States and the Lokpal at the Centre investigate corruption. The Second Administrative Reforms Commission gave its fourth report to ethics in governance.

left.title: Merely legal
items: follows the letter of the rules

segments.say: Probity goes further than staying within the law. It means following the spirit of the rules, not just their letter.
For GS Four, quote these standards in your answers, and show how one real decision can meet them.

sources: PIB, All India Services (Conduct) Rules, 1968 Amended, 8 August 2014 (relid 108295): new rule 3(1A) (high ethical standards, integrity and honesty; political neutrality; merit, fairness and impartiality; accountability and transparency; responsiveness to the public, particularly weaker sections; courtesy) and rule 3(2B) (uphold the Constitution; decisions solely in public interest; use public resources efficiently; declare any private interests relating to public duties and resolve conflicts in a way that protects the public interest; no financial or other obligations that may influence official duties; not misuse position for benefit of self, family or friends; decide on merit alone; maintain confidentiality as required by law)

PIB, speech on Lokayuktas (relid 88815, read): Lokayuktas set up across the country to investigate corruption and help bring probity in governance; the Second Administrative Reforms Commission, in its Fourth Report on 'Ethics in Governance', recommended uniform principles for Lokayuktas

quiz.q: Which of these is one of the standards in the 2014 amendment to the All India Services (Conduct) Rules?
quiz.why: Rule 3(1A) lists political neutrality among six standards.

quiz.q: Which Second ARC report dealt with 'Ethics in Governance'?
quiz.why: PIB: the Fourth Report, 'Ethics in Governance'.

options: Following only the letter of the law
Honesty and uprightness in public life, even when unobserved
quiz.why: Probity follows the spirit of the rules, not just the letter.
